name: I’m ~Kokoro no  Mukougawa ni~
source:
Main character is a shy high school student. One day he awakens at school because of the voice in his head. From this day he decides to make many memories with someone. Once he gets in peculiar encounter and starts to wonder which girl participated in it.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位害羞的高中生。有一天，他在学校醒来，因为脑海中的声音。从这一天起，他决定与某人留下许多回忆。一旦他遇到了奇怪的遭遇，他开始想知道哪个女孩参与了其中。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
